schema_version.description: Version of the common economic interpretation and field contract.

accountability_event_id.description: SHA-256 identity derived from protocol-native keys; identifies this representation, not a person or a factual proposition.

oracle_network.description: Oracle protocol branch; not necessarily the chain that stores or settles the observation.

security_chain.description: Chain or native execution system recording the security or settlement evidence.

delivery_chain.description: Chain receiving the oracle result, when observed.

x-enumDefinitions.request: One oracle request round, identified by the native request ID.
x-enumDefinitions.individual_report: One native report or authenticated update; not a unique independent real-world fact.
x-enumDefinitions.dispute: A native dispute or a vote/payment event linked to a dispute; consult event_granularity.
x-enumDefinitions.voting_request: Voter-level accrual linked to a DVM request; multiple voters share the request ID.
x-enumDefinitions.reward_epoch: A provider, beneficiary or claim observation linked to a protocol reward epoch.
x-enumDefinitions.publisher_pool_epoch: Pyth publisher epoch, stake instruction or reward transfer; native granularity remains essential.
x-enumDefinitions.service_availability_window: Chainlink service interval or staking action; consult native_table and event_granularity.
x-enumDefinitions.reporter_jail_lifecycle: Tellor jail/release event; two rows may belong to one restriction lifecycle.
x-enumDefinitions.staking_position: DIA withdrawal against a native staking position index.

accountability_unit_type.description: Protocol-native unit family; interpretations are enumerated in semantic_decisions.json.

accountability_unit_id.description: Native object identity; one object can contribute multiple typed events.

event_granularity.description: Specific kind of native action/component represented by this row.

event_time_unix.description: Observed native event timestamp in UTC Unix seconds; null when the retained source has no time.

actor.description: Public pseudonymous address or protocol identifier associated with this row, qualified by actor_role.

actor_role.description: Role of the actor for this observation; may be outcome-derived and is excluded from T0 predictive features.

counterparty.description: Other protocol participant or contract, when identified by native evidence.

counterparty_role.description: Role of the counterparty relative to the recorded action.

reward_class.description: Reward mechanism and economic stage; accrued, claimable and paid classes must not be combined.

reward_amount_raw.description: Integer amount associated with reward_class; this field alone does not imply payment.

reward_asset.description: Token contract, symbol or denomination for reward_amount_raw.

reward_asset_decimals.description: Number of decimal places for the reward asset; divide raw token units by 10**decimals.

reward_accrual_time_unix.description: UTC Unix seconds at which the entitlement accrues, if observed.

reward_payment_time_unix.description: UTC Unix seconds of an observed reward payment, if observed.

penalty_class.description: Penalty mechanism and realization stage; accrued penalties are not applied principal losses.

principal_slashed_raw.description: Applied principal loss supported by native state/settlement evidence. Null means no quantified applied loss is established.

bond_forfeited_raw.description: Posted bond amount forfeited under the settled protocol outcome, separate from returned principal and fees.

fee_forfeited_raw.description: Protocol fee component lost by the affected participant, separate from the bond.

reward_forfeited_raw.description: Previously eligible/accrued reward lost under protocol rules; not principal slashing.

penalty_asset.description: Token identifier or denomination for the penalty amount.

penalty_asset_decimals.description: Decimal precision of the penalty token.

nonmonetary_penalty.description: Native restriction such as jail/chill, distinct from a quantified token loss.

principal_locked_raw.description: Observable participant principal at risk; for UMA the effective bond plus final fee, for Tellor the escrow amount, never report power.

principal_returned_raw.description: Participant principal included in a settlement return; excluded from token gain and reward.

principal_asset.description: Token identifier or denomination of posted/returned principal.

principal_asset_decimals.description: Decimal precision of the principal token.

truth_basis.description: What the evidence establishes; protocol adjudication, signatures and state transitions are not independent factual truth.

x-enumDefinitions.undisputed_acceptance: Protocol acceptance without adjudication; does not establish factual truth.
x-enumDefinitions.protocol_vote_adjudication: Protocol voting outcome, not independent factual ground truth.
x-enumDefinitions.consensus_median_alignment: Agreement with the protocol aggregate, not an independent reference.
x-enumDefinitions.independent_reference_adjudication: Adjudication against an explicitly identified independent reference; not inferred from a transfer.
x-enumDefinitions.service_availability_condition: Recorded service or eligibility condition, without a factual truth judgment.
x-enumDefinitions.external_ground_truth: Independent factual label requiring its own source and validation.
x-enumDefinitions.protocol_aggregate: Tellor native report/aggregate inclusion; does not certify the report as true.
x-enumDefinitions.signed_payload_verification: RedStone authenticated payload evidence; signatures authenticate a source, not the price.
x-enumDefinitions.cryptographic_validation_and_challenge: Chronicle validation/challenge mechanism; factual truth is not independently observed.
x-enumDefinitions.protocol_recognized_reporting: Tellor report recognized for a payment; recognition is not external truth.
x-enumDefinitions.staking_participation_not_individual_rep: DIA staking withdrawal evidence, with no individual report correctness label.
x-enumDefinitions.protocol_state_transition: Observed Pyth stake/transfer state transition without independent factual adjudication.

outcome_status.description: Protocol-native outcome or classified state; interpretation requires native_table and rule_id.

external_truth_available.description: Whether an independent factual reference is supplied, not merely a protocol vote.

service_window_seconds.description: Elapsed seconds in the observed service interval.

service_threshold_seconds.description: Registered protocol service threshold in seconds.

source_event.description: Name of the native log, instruction or state evidence used.

source_tx.description: Source transaction hash/signature; chain identity must also be retained.

source_block.description: Native block number/height, not a wall-clock timestamp.

source_log_index.description: Position of the source log within its transaction/block convention.

source_contract.description: Contract/program address emitting or governing the evidence.

rule_id.description: Versioned transformation or interpretation rule identifier.

parameter_version.description: Protocol configuration or parameter version used for interpretation.

observability_grade.description: Evidence/coverage grade A, B, C or U; not a factual truth or economic validity guarantee.

confidence_grade.description: Registered linkage/interpretation grade A, B, C or U.

native_table.description: Name of the native input table to which the observation can be traced.

sample_tier.description: Declared cohort or scope category; cohorts can overlap.

interpretation_note.description: Source-specific meaning, stage distinction or limitation retained with the record.

penalty_accrued_raw.description: Calculated negative accrual magnitude; not realized loss and not additive to the later applied net change.
